title: Perplexity says GPT-6 Astra can handle end-to-end systems with less supervision
friendlyTitle: Perplexity gives an AI model bigger software jobs
summary: Perplexity says it is using GPT-6 Astra to write communications, change software, monitor production systems and build realistic end-to-end tests. The account is an OpenAI customer case study, so its performance claims should be read as company-reported rather than independent evaluation.
friendlySummary: Perplexity says GPT-6 Astra can change software, watch live systems and create tests. This is a company case study, not an independent test.
whyItMatters: The useful pattern is not simply more autonomous coding: it is asking an agent to create tests and evidence around the work it performs. Teams adopting longer-running agents should make those artefacts part of review rather than reducing oversight on trust alone.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can save more time when it also shows proof that its work is correct. People should still review that proof before important changes go live.
